causal_question: After a common spot-perpetual shock removes a frozen external auction boundary, does failure to extend plus completed reclaim reveal passive absorption or active flow reversal toward the opposite accepted-range liquidity?

first_week.selection_method: deterministic shuffle of eligible Monday weeks after excluding all previously revealed candidate-02 weeks

promotion_rule: Central 30m and at least one adjacent horizon must pass every gate. Any component with at least two trades must be nonnegative. Only then may an unchanged rule be locked before a new second week is selected.

states.cause: aggressive flow remains in the sweep direction while price fails to extend and reclaims the frozen boundary
states.entry: opposite the shock after completed reclaim
states.invalidation: beyond the observed sweep extreme plus ATR buffer

states.cause: aggressive flow itself reverses after the common shock removes external liquidity and price reclaims the boundary
states.entry: opposite the shock after completed reclaim
states.invalidation: beyond the observed sweep extreme plus ATR buffer

states.cause: no reclaim or confirmation flow between the separated states
